title: Two Ways to Blush
caption:
Two Ways to Blush

The same soft pink looks different in liquid and in powder.

Liquid melts into the skin, for a flush that seems to come from within.
Powder gives a soft, airy finish.

Neither one is the right answer.
Choose by how your skin feels that day, and the expression you want.

Choosing texture, not only colour, is how makeup becomes your own.
